orientation: Decide from change status and formal release, not formatting.

concepts.name: draft
non_features: Polished formatting alone does not establish draft status
A memo formally released to staff is not a draft

concepts.name: published
defining_features: Formally released to its intended audience
non_features: Polished formatting alone does not establish publication
A privately saved memo is not published

boundary_cases.case: Memo emailed to all staff after approval

recognition_cues: Ask whether substantive changes remain open.
Ask whether the content was formally released to its intended audience.
Ignore formatting polish as proof of publication.

evidence.claim: A memo awaiting author review is a draft.
An approved memo emailed to all staff is published.

unresolved_ambiguities: The evidence does not rule out content satisfying both definitions.
The evidence does not establish that every item must satisfy one definition, so an either-or question is unsupported.
